text:
@typesafeai's Jev as a DuckDB UDF (User Defined Function) on flight destinations:

SELECT destination,
  jev(destination, 'has a beach and mountains
      with vegan food and cold weather') AS score
FROM flights
ORDER BY score DESC;

218 rows. 4 seconds. No embeddings, no vector…
